primitives.name: Wild Pitch Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: A "wild pitch" is a ball delivered by the pitcher so wide of the mark that the catcher cannot recover it before the runner has advanced a base.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_w': 'probability of wild pitch occurrence', 'T_r': 'time interval between pitch delivery and runner advancement', 'D_c': "distance from catcher's position to ball recovery point"}
primitives.assumptions: Pitch trajectory deviates beyond catcher's reaction time; runner advances without interference.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D_c > v_c * T_r, where v_c is catcher's average speed.

layer2.mapping: Maps pitch deviation to runner advancement via kinematic constraints and timing thresholds.
layer2.telemetry: Runner advancement rate under pitch deviation conditions.

primitives.name: Sacrifice Hit Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: A "sacrifice hit" is a ball so batted as to advance a base-runner while it gives an opportunity of putting out the man batting it.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H_s': 'hit type indicator for sacrifice', 'R_a': 'runner advancement in bases', 'O_p': 'opportunity for outs (fielder targeting)'}
primitives.assumptions: Batter intentionally sacrifices for strategic advancement; fielders prioritize preventing further advancement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R_a > 0 but O_p remains high due to batter's positioning.

layer2.mapping: Encodes trade-off between runner advancement and out probability using game-theoretic payoff matrices.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of sacrifice hits per inning vs. runner advancement metrics.

primitives.name: Double Play Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: In this way he makes what is called a double play, putting out both men.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_p': 'double play success rate', 'T_d': 'time window for sequential throw execution', 'F_i': 'fielder index for initial and secondary throws'}
primitives.assumptions: Defensive players execute rapid, coordinated throws within time constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_d < min(T_throws(F_i)) across all involved fielders.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphically maps to multi-agent coordination protocols in combinatorial game theory.
layer2.telemetry: Success rate of double plays based on fielder reaction times and throw accuracy.
